tasks.gr11-literature-revision-t4: Topic: Comprehensive literature revision across all genres for Grade 11 English HL. Cover novel, drama, poetry, thematic revision, and quotation recall. Ask learners to match quotations to themes, identify the genre conventions of novel, drama, and poetry, explain a theme with supporting evidence, distinguish between plot and theme, and answer integrated literature questions that require knowledge across more than one genre.
tasks.gr11-writing-consolidation-t4: Topic: Writing consolidation across all FET essay and transactional forms for Grade 11 English HL. Cover essay revision (narrative, descriptive, argumentative, discursive, reflective), transactional writing format revision, editing under timed conditions, and choosing the most suitable topic. Ask learners to identify format errors in transactional tasks, choose the correct essay type for a given prompt, revise a weak paragraph, apply the correct salutation and sign-off in formal letters, and plan a timed essay in five minutes.
tasks.gr11-exam-readiness-t4: Topic: Exam readiness and paper-structure strategies for Grade 11 English HL covering Papers 1, 2, and 3. Cover Paper 1 comprehension and language routines, Paper 2 contextual and essay questions on prescribed literature, Paper 3 essay and transactional writing timing, and common exam traps. Ask learners to identify which section of each paper tests a specific skill, describe the correct approach to an unseen comprehension passage, explain how to avoid common exam pitfalls, allocate time appropriately across three papers, and identify the distinguishing features of a strong Paper 2 contextual response.
